summary: PrankFX backend fully tested via public preview URL. All 28 pytest cases passed (100%) across health, email/password auth, effects catalog, premium gating, mock subscription flow, real Nano Banana AI generation, project CRUD with favorites+search, and account deletion.

minor.issue: Only deletes session_token from user_sessions. JWTs issued via email/password login remain valid until expiry (30 days). Documented via test — behavior is by design but frontend must discard JWT client-side. Consider a token blacklist if stronger logout semantics are required.
email-validator library rejects TLDs that RFC 2606 marks as reserved (e.g. `.test`, `.example`, `.invalid`). Not a bug, but worth noting for callers writing tests; use `example.com`-style domains.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: If stricter logout semantics are needed, invalidate JWTs server-side (blacklist or short exp + refresh token).
Optional: In production, replace mock subscription with real Stripe checkout (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY currently empty in .env).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 528 lines — nearing the 700-line split threshold but still acceptable. Consider splitting auth, subscription, generate, projects into routers as feature set grows.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via find projections everywhere ({"_id": 0}). Verified in tests.
Password hashing uses bcrypt with gensalt() — good.

get_current_user cleanly supports BOTH JWT and Emergent Google session_token on the same /api/auth/me endpoint — verified via test_me_with_jwt (Google session flow not exercised because it requires a real Emergent session_id).

Premium gating logic in _is_effect_allowed is correct: face_effects tier unlocks only face; ultimate unlocks everything — verified via TestSubscription.test_face_tier_cannot_access_ultimate_effect (402 for vehicle).
Real Nano Banana call succeeded end-to-end in ~9-12s with a 256x256 PNG using model `gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview` — result_image base64 returned and persisted to Mongo when save_to_history=true.
Effects catalog properly hides raw prompts from public /api/effects response — verified.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ prefixed users and delete them (via DELETE /api/auth/account) at end of each class. One real AI-generated project was created for demo user and then deleted in test_delete_project. Demo user premium_tier ends set to `ultimate` (mock-activated during AI test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_prankfx_api.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (must pass `-n 0` to override the pytest.ini `-n 2 --dist loadscope` because several tests share class-level state and would race under parallel workers). Email domain must be non-reserved (use `.com`, NOT `.test`). AI generation test takes 10-15s; timeout is 180s.
